name: Erdafitinib (oral FGFR inhibitor)
cyclesNote: Continuous daily oral dosing until progression or unacceptable toxicity; a 28-day cycle is used for administrative tracking. Uptitrate from 8 mg to 9 mg once daily on day 14-21 if serum phosphate is below target and no significant toxicity.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Erdafitinib requires a qualifying FGFR2 or FGFR3 activating mutation or fusion on molecular testing. It is used after prior platinum-based systemic therapy and is not a substitute for immunotherapy or an antibody-drug conjugate in FGFR-wild-type disease.

supportiveCare: Serum phosphate guides dose titration; manage hyperphosphatemia with a low-phosphate diet, phosphate binders, and dose modification.
Baseline and periodic ophthalmologic exams (including OCT) for central serous retinopathy / retinal pigment epithelial detachment; advise dry-eye prophylaxis.
Monitor nails and skin (onycholysis, hand-foot skin changes) and oral mucosa (stomatitis, dry mouth).
monitoring: serum phosphate at baseline, on day 14-21 (for uptitration), and periodically
ophthalmologic exam at baseline and periodically (central serous retinopathy)
nail, skin, and oral mucosal assessment each visit

doseModificationRules.condition: hyperphosphatemia above target despite diet / binders
doseModificationRules.text: Add phosphate binders and reduce or interrupt erdafitinib for persistent hyperphosphatemia per labeling thresholds; physician decides.

doseModificationRules.condition: central serous retinopathy / retinal pigment epithelial detachment
doseModificationRules.text: Hold erdafitinib for symptomatic or significant serous retinal detachment; resume reduced or discontinue based on ophthalmology assessment.

drugs.name: Erdafitinib
drugs.notes: Erdafitinib 8 mg orally once daily, taken continuously (day 1 marks the start of continuous daily dosing). Uptitrate to 9 mg once daily on day 14-21 if serum phosphate is below the target threshold and there is no significant toxicity. Requires a qualifying FGFR2/FGFR3 alteration. Dose per standard urothelial practice (Standard Guidelines / DeVita / Harrison, general reference).

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy, FGFR-altered post-platinum
